description: Machine-readable interface capability matrix (task book section 12). Values describe whether an explicitly documented entry point can express a feature; they are not a claim of behavioural equivalence. 'no'/'partial' entries carry a note.
limitations: Advanced explicit atom mapping/image-shift control is available through API/direct CLI/TUI only; the INCAR-style key set deliberately does not expose neb_atom_map or neb_image_shifts.
The interface capability matrix is not an equivalence claim: a 'yes' means the entry point can express the feature, not that every validation scenario is covered through it.
